description: This Java class 'LoanItemProcessor' extends 'AbstractLoanItemProcessor' and appears to be part of a batch processing workflow related to loans within the Apache Fineract project. It uses Spring Batch annotations and services to process loan items during a batch job.

classes.name: LoanItemProcessor
classes.description: A batch item processor for handling loan-related processing steps within a larger COB (Close of Business) batch workflow. It initializes processing with step execution context and business date.

methods.name: LoanItemProcessor
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the processor with a COB business step service.

methods.name: beforeStep
methods.description: Callback method invoked before the batch step begins, used to set up execution context and business date.
